scope: Move device-removal challenge, timestamp, and proof collection into the host while preserving the management endpoint and its retry contract.
findings: Device removal previously required applications to supply an operation-bound proof and timestamp.
The host now collects selected-method proof with the existing shared collector; auth-method removal retains surviving-sibling selection.
The email contract verifies a refused revocation commit, exact retry, revocation enforcement on the linked device, and continued owner signing.
The passkey contract verifies linked-device NEAR/Tempo signing, lost acknowledgement recovery, revocation and owner continuity.
reproduce: SEAMS_INTENDED_PRODUCTION=1 SEAMS_INTENDED_SKIP_BUILD=1 node tests/scripts/run-wallet-intended-isolated.mjs --require-google-token -- e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.device-linking.contract.test.ts --grep 'a linked device revoked with an email code across a refused commit is answered from what committed'

SEAMS_INTENDED_PRODUCTION=1 SEAMS_INTENDED_SKIP_BUILD=1 node tests/scripts/run-wallet-intended-isolated.mjs -- e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.device-linking.contract.test.ts --grep 'a second device links with a passkey, signs NEAR and Tempo, and is revoked'
